en.headline: ChinaAMC launches three Hong Kong ETFs targeting dividends, growth and cross-market strategies
en.dek: The funds, set to list on 30 September with HKD, RMB and USD counters, expand the firm’s range as investors seek more specialised products.
body: China Asset Management (Hong Kong) launched three new exchange-traded funds on Thursday: a Hong Kong high-dividend ETF, a Hong Kong growth ETF and a Hong Kong-US “Halo” ETF.

The products are scheduled to list on the Hong Kong stock exchange on 30 September and will offer trading counters in Hong Kong dollars, renminbi and US dollars. The firm said the launch reflects growing demand for targeted strategies beyond broad market exposure and could support future participation under ETF Connect within about six months.

Tian Gan, chief executive of ChinaAMC (HK), said the range of Hong Kong-focused and cross-market products underscores the city’s role connecting local and international markets. The announcement came as investors continue to seek more diversified tools amid market volatility.

zh.headline: 華夏基金推三隻港股主題ETF 高息、增長及港美策略
zh.dek: 三隻產品定於9月30日上市，設港元、人民幣及美元櫃台，反映投資者對特定策略需求上升。
body: 華夏基金（香港）周四推出三隻全新交易所買賣基金，包括華夏富時港股高息ETF、華夏港股增長ETF及華夏港美HALO ETF。
三隻產品將於9月30日在港交所上市，並設港元、人民幣及美元櫃台。公司表示，港股ETF市場正由廣泛市場產品擴展至更特定策略，新產品有望在約六個月內納入ETF通，方便內地投資者參與。
華夏基金（香港）行政總裁田甘表示，推出本港及跨境策略產品，體現香港連接本地與國際市場的角色。是次推出正值市場波動期間，投資者對更多元化工具需求上升。
